messages:
carlos (customer): Hey team — seeing lots of partial SSE payloads today from our app to Redwood API. Stream starts fine then client reconnects and we get truncated last event. Also noticed a billing spike since yesterday :confused:

julia (support): Sorry about that. Can you paste a minimal repro curl or client snippet and the request headers? Any proxy in front of you?

carlos (customer): Using an in-house gateway (gRPC -> http1 proxy) in front of our browser clients. Here's a trimmed curl that reproduces locally:

```bash
# works over http/2 but fails via our gateway
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  --http2 https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?prompt=test
```

When routed through the gateway we see partial events and then the client reconnects. The final "data: [DONE]" is sometimes missing.

rajesh (ingress): That smells like an intermediary buffering/flush problem. Many gRPC->HTTP1 bridges (and some Envoy configs) coalesce small writes until a flush or certain chunk pattern. If the client reconnects mid-output it can look truncated. Which gateway are you using (Envoy/Traefik/nginx/istio)?

carlos (customer): We're on a bespoke gRPC-web translation layer but it uses Envoy as the edge. Envoy config has default http1/2 options.

julia (support): Can you share a capture of the raw bytes (curl --raw or tcpdump) or the request/response headers? Also include a trace_id from our logs if you have one.

carlos (customer): Trace id: trc-7b9a4e2c. Raw response shows chunks combined into one TCP packet like: 

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: text/event-stream
transfer-encoding: chunked

5
data:

14
 ["partial",

0


```

so the final "data: [DONE]" never arrives before the connection is torn.

emily (sre): Two hypotheses: 1) Envoy http1 codec is waiting to aggregate or not flushing on small writes; 2) midstream auth rotation or token refresh triggers a renegotiation and the gateway tears the connection. Also billing spike could be because client reconnects cause new full-stream billable sessions.

julia (support): We should repro in our staging with identical Envoy config. Quick tests: try forcing HTTP/1.1 on curl and compare to http2: `--http1.1` vs `--http2`. Also try `curl -N --no-buffer` to avoid libc buffering.

carlos (customer): With `--http1.1 --no-buffer` I still get truncated events through the gateway. Direct to our origin (bypassing gateway) works.

rajesh (ingress): Can you paste the Envoy listener/route http1 settings? Two knobs to try: `stream_idle_timeout` and `use_remote_address`/`connection_buffer_limit_bytes`. Also check the `flush` behavior for gRPC-web filter. In some setups you need `envoy.http_connection_manager` with `delayed_close_timeout` tuned.

emily (sre): From an SRE angle: please collect these artifacts and attach to the ticket: 1) tcpdump of client->gateway and gateway->redwood for same session 2) envoy config snapshot 3) full curl request with `-v` and `--http1.1` 4) our API logs for trc-7b9a4e2c (I can pull if you share account/region).

carlos (customer): Putting logs together. Quick workaround request: can Redwood support a tolerant retry policy that merges partials on reconnect? Right now each reconnect starts a new billable generation which doubled our usage.

julia (support): We don't merge partial outputs automatically because it can corrupt semantics, but we can add guidance: 1) client should detect duplicate/replay and dedupe server responses (using a session id header) 2) enable short-lived KV cache on the client side to re-use partial prefix if reconnect happens. I'll open an internal feature request for more robust partial-session stitching.

emily (sre): In parallel, I'll spin up a staging Envoy with your config and try to reproduce. If it's Envoy flush/coalescing we'll propose a config patch (`per_try_idle_timeout` / `max_connection_duration`) and a note to avoid gRPC-web translation mid-stream.

rajesh (ingress): One more quick repro you can try: force chunk boundaries on the server by sending an extra newline after each SSE event and toggling `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` write sizes. Example server pseudocode: `write("data: ...\n\n"); flush(); write("\n");` If that fixes it, it's definitely an intermediary flush problem.

carlos (customer): Thanks. I'll run those tests and attach tcpdumps and envoy config. Appreciate the fast help :pray: 

deploy-bot: Deploy success for staging/ingress-config @ 1719998280 :thumbsup:

julia (support): Keeping this thread open. Next steps: carlos uploads artifacts -> we repro in staging -> eng/sre recommends Envoy config change and client retry guidance -> we coordinate to minimize billing impact.

emily (sre): FYI if we confirm Envoy cause we can provide a short-term proxy rule to force `Connection: close` per-chunk for affected routes to avoid coalescing while customers roll out config changes.

carlos (customer): Uploaded files: /uploads/trc-7b9a4e2c-envoy.cfg, /uploads/trc-7b9a4e2c-tcpdump.pcap. Thanks all.
